question: How do people worship the supreme Lord through conceptual means?
premises: People may approach the supreme Lord wholly or partially.
Their approach can be shaped by impressions arising from streams of concepts.
These conceptual impressions may be awakened by scripture.
inference: Those shaped by scripturally awakened conceptual impressions worship the all-pervading supreme Lord either wholly or partially.
uncertainties: The exact construal of vikalpaughasaṃskārādye is compressed and may admit slight variation in emphasis.
plain_english: Thus, those whose mental impressions arise from streams of concepts awakened by scripture worship that all-pervading supreme Lord, either wholly or in part.
